hypothesis: A shared fail-closed forward-health contract can recover iBorrowDesk fair progress and prevent ORTEX partial or stale content from being reported ready without changing any trading decision.
alpha_hypothesis_deferred: A first positive USD cash dividend declaration after at least 1095 days without a same-ticker positive USD declaration may create costed H10 replacement value, but the outcome-blind research-PIT lead remains frozen pending a later D0-D3 and model-diverse promotion cycle.

iborrowdesk.scheduler: Eligibility remains based on last successful refresh age; shard priority is now based on oldest last attempt with last success as fallback, so recently failed names rotate behind unattempted or older-attempt names.
iborrowdesk.boundedness: max_fetches and max_consecutive_failures remain unchanged; append-only daily history is unchanged.

ortex.pagination: The daily CTB range fetch follows every same-origin paginationLinks.next page, rejects cycles, malformed links, later-page HTTP or JSON failures, continuation at max_pages, and projected credit-bound breaches before any normalized row is persisted.
ortex.accounting: creditsUsed is summed across pages, creditsLeft comes from the final page, and physical pages are reported as requests_made, http_requests_made, and pages_fetched; the four-ticker daily selection cap is unchanged.
ortex.freshness: Snapshot coverage and provider content identity are evaluated separately. Any ticker beyond five completed exchange sessions is stale; when a complete session calendar is unavailable, a seven-calendar-day weekday fallback also applies. Stale full coverage is status=stale_content and ready=false.

verification.integration_command: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m pytest quant\test_iborrowdesk_data_source.py quant\test_ortex_data_sidecar.py quant\test_ortex_borrow_observer.py quant\test_ortex_borrow_entry_gate.py quant\test_ortex_moomoo_borrow_pair_paper_sleeve.py quant\test_run_daily_wiring.py -q

production_impact.scope: observer producer scheduling, pagination, and fail-closed health only

operational_follow_up: On the next scheduled producer run, verify iBorrowDesk attempts a shard other than ABC/ANTM/BF-B/BK/BOK and either adds rows or reports a genuine host failure; verify ORTEX either advances provider dates with complete pages or remains explicitly stale/failed, never ready. No experiment ID is needed for that one-line health check.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Both failures were deterministic control-plane defects: success-age priority ignored recent failed attempts, while a first-page-only fetch and coverage-only readiness confused process completion with fresh content.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not reserve separate IDs to retune retry order, page size, stale threshold, or manually refresh either observer. Routine production verification and future daily materialization do not consume IDs.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only for an independently observed source-format change, a pagination or credit semantic incompatibility, or another content-identity failure that persists after this repaired contract.
